rationale: personality01 was cached as a stale entry at commit e8f2b9ca6 — it passed in Asterinas under selector mode but remains commented out in all.txt. The test exercises personality(2), setting 19 distinct personalities and reading them back, a narrow syscall semantic test with no subsystem dependencies. The syscall is already implemented (syscall/mod.rs and arch/x86.rs line 232), so this enables existing functionality without a kernel fix. Picked from among 32 stale-entry candidates at the exact base commit because personality is uncovered ground (earlier rounds covered IPC/timers/fs) and the test requires no mounts or block devices, minimizing external failure modes. Host baseline confirms 19/19 pass on real Linux.
